subject: general
question:
The circle positioned above represents people who like cricket. The circle to your left represents people who like volleyball and the circle to your right represents people who like basketball.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e064287a1c34fd3a24ded6b684dc8529c75eaf730ca322e69dd65cebef88dd1.png] 

How many people like volleyball?
solution:
The Venn diagram is given below:-

The circle positioned above represents people who like cricket,

The circle to your left represents people who like volleyball,

The circle to your right represents people who like basketball.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cef05bacf999e9ae435f2947634d8928a08461de7ba24e13839f13dcd9ffa0c8.png] 

The people who like volleyball = 6 + 21 + 12 + 4 = 43.

Hence, **"option 4"** is the correct answer.
